name: command
need: Find and run any command of the app from one search field (Ctrl+K)

--ds-command-top.description: the room above the command palette's box

--ds-command-height.description: the command palette's box at most

--ds-command-search-height.description: the command palette's search row at md and the comfortable density

--ds-command-item-height.description: a command palette option at md and the comfortable density

--ds-command-item-radius.description: a command palette option's radius at the default shape

labExempt.DS.command.fuzzy: a score and ranges: no motion

ripple..ds-command__item: an option of the listbox: focus stays in the field, the active layer is the feedback (as the combobox option)
ripple..ds-command__back: the page's label before the field, out of the tab order: Backspace and Escape are its keys, a click its pointer path
